name: trace-prd-auto
description: TRACE with automatic capture: hooks log each tool event (redacted) in projects that have a TRACE.md, and optional background proposals run after each turn with your own API key. Requires Node.js 18+. For the hook-free edition, install trace-prd.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key (optional)
anthropic_api_key.description: Your own key, used only for background proposals after each turn. Stored in your OS credential store. Leave empty to generate proposals in-session with /trace-prd-auto:review instead.

model.title: Background model
model.description: Model used for background proposals (three short calls per editing turn). Ignored when no API key is set.
